goal: Repository, build and evidence management: one commit in, one attributable artifact out.
closed_by: runs 43885772410 and 43887531094 on commit 1c08cab: the kernel, the payload and the deployable stage tree were produced by CI, each with a manifest, and the differences between two builds of one commit are named.

criteria.requirement: A validate or kernel run of this repository is recorded with its run id in docs/ci/RUNS.md, so every 'CI produced this' claim can be opened.
criteria.note: Run 43830315484 on a2a14e3: validate, efi-preflight, gicv2-emulation and kernel all succeeded in 8m48s. It predates the manifest and the link assertion, so it does not close P0.2 or P0.4.

criteria.requirement: Every kernel run writes out/build-manifest.json with all fifteen input fields and a SHA-256 for every produced artifact, and the run fails if a field is missing or an output hash does not match.
criteria.note: Run 43885772410 wrote it and the step re-hashed every output in the same job: repo 1c08cab clean, framework 1a01c2a patched, kernelcache 2ec297ba, the device lock, Xcode 26.6 / iPhoneOS SDK 26.5 / clang 23.1.5, eight archives plus the kernel, the report and its stripped/unstripped forms. The artifact carries it (out/build-manifest.json).

criteria.requirement: Two runs of the same commit produce the same kernel SHA-256, or the difference is named and bounded.
criteria.note: Runs 43885772410 and 43887531094 on 1c08cab differ. scripts/check-reproducible.py classifies every differing byte: 1,911 of 18,783,720 (0.0102%) -- the 16-byte LC_UUID, 6 bytes of the XNU version banner in __TEXT,__const, and 1,889 bytes of timestamps in debug information that is not loaded. The prelink report differs in exactly two of 77,557 values (native_sha256, candidate_sha256). Closing the banner gap needs a pinned build epoch, which is not attempted.

criteria.requirement: Every component in board.toml [kernel] archives has a symbol in the linked image and an archive on disk, so `kernel-linked` is produced by a job rather than assumed.
criteria.note: Run 43885772410: NativeMdss, NativeAdreno418 and NativeLegacyDisplay are in the image and their archives are on disk. NativeSdhci is excluded with a recorded reason (board.toml [kernel.link_excluded]): its superclass lives in IOStorageFamily, which exists only after the prelink merge. The exclusion is checked, not assumed: the checker refuses an exclusion with no reason or one the board does not build.

criteria.requirement: The evidence labels (source-reviewed ... userland-booted) are enforced by a checker over docs/evidence.json, not only defined in AGENTS.md.
criteria.note: The table exists and the checker runs in validate. It ties XNU-entry-tested to P1 being met and userland-booted to P4, so neither can be claimed by editing this file alone. Both phases are open, so nothing in the table is above EFI-tested.
